seo.title: Salon Mastery Home
seo.description: Salon business advisory for owners ready to lead, structure, and scale.

props.title: From an "I-do-everything-myself" salon to a structured, profitable business in 3-6 months.
props.subtitle: For salon owners who want more profit, less chair time, and a team that runs without them.
bullets: 5-15 fewer hours per week in operations
props.ctaMeta: 30-45 min via Zoom . Limited to qualified salon owners

painPoints.title: Everything depends on you
painPoints.body: You are the operator, marketer, trainer, and closer. The salon does not run, you run it.

painPoints.title: No clarity on numbers
painPoints.body: Revenue moves through the salon, but margins and profit per service stay foggy.

painPoints.title: Your team waits for direction
painPoints.body: Capable people hover until you tell them what to do next.

painPoints.title: Revenue is up, profit feels unclear
painPoints.body: Months look strong on paper, but effort and final profit do not match.

painPoints.title: Always busy, rarely building
painPoints.body: Days disappear into appointments, fires, and admin.

painPoints.title: The business cannot run without you
painPoints.body: A real holiday feels impossible and critical decisions loop back to you.

methodSteps.title: Clarity over numbers
methodSteps.body: Create a clear picture of revenue, costs, profit, and where the salon is leaking money.

methodSteps.title: Pricing and profit structure
methodSteps.body: Adjust pricing, service structure, and profitability so the business becomes healthier.

methodSteps.title: Salon structure
methodSteps.body: Build clear roles, responsibilities, and systems so everything no longer depends on the owner.

methodSteps.title: Digital back office
methodSteps.body: Organize the salon's operations with simple digital tools and workflows.

methodSteps.title: Team ownership
methodSteps.body: Train the team to think, act, and take responsibility without waiting for direction.

methodSteps.title: Real implementation
methodSteps.body: Apply the system step by step inside the salon, not only in theory.
